query:
SELECT userid                 AS "user_id!",
                   createat               AS "create_at?",
                   requiredplan           AS "required_plan!",
                   requiredfeature        AS "required_feature!",
                   trial                  AS "trial!",
                   sentat                 AS "sent_at?"
              FROM notifyadmin
             WHERE trial = $1 AND sentat IS NULL
